'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Lebanon war]]
***[[September 2024 Israeli attacks against Lebanon|September 2024 Lebanon strikes]]
****At least 95 people are killed and 172 others are injured in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s in [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/30/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-israel-expands-strikes-on-beirut-as-105-killed?update=3212669 (Al Jazeera)]
****Five children belonging to the [[Imam al-Mahdi Scouts]] are killed in an [[Israel]]i airstrike in [[Charkiyeh]] in [[Southern Lebanon|southern]] Lebanon. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/5-children-killed-in-israeli-strike-in-southern-lebanon/3346011 (Anadolu Agency)]
****Three militants of the [[Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine]] are killed in an Israeli airstrike in the Kola District of [[Beirut]], Lebanon. Separately, [[Hamas]]'s commander in Lebanon, [[Fatah Sharif]], is killed alongside his family in [[Tyre, Lebanon|Tyre]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/30/israeli-attacks-kill-105-people-in-lebanon-as-war-escalates (Al Jazeera)]
****A [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese Army]] soldier is killed in an Israeli [[drone warfare|drone strike]] in [[Wazzani]], Lebanon. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/lebanese-army-says-soldier-killed-in-israeli-drone-strike/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
****Israel informs the [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] that it will launch an imminent ground [[invasion]] of southern Lebanon in order to clear out [[Hezbollah]] infrastructure near Israeli border communities. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/09/30/israel-lebanon-hezbollah-hamas-war-news-gaza/ (''The Washington Post'')]
****Lebanese troops withdraw from [[Blue Line (withdrawal line)|the Israeli border]] ahead of an Israeli ground offensive. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/apartment-building-beirut-hit-israel-widens-air-campaign-2024-09-29/ (Reuters)]
***[[Lebanese displacement during the Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Lebanese displacement during the Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
****The [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees]] reports that at least 100,000 people have crossed from Lebanon into [[Syria]] in order to flee from Israeli strikes. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/30/israeli-bombardment-of-lebanon-sends-100000-fleeing-to-war-torn-syria-un (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Coal phase-out]]
**The last [[Ratcliffe-on-Soar Power Station|coal-fired power station]] in the [[United Kingdom]] shuts down in [[Ratcliffe-on-Soar]], [[Nottinghamshire]], [[England]], ending the 142-year history of coal-fired electricity [[Energy in the United Kingdom|in the UK]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2024/sep/30/end-of-an-era-as-britains-last-coal-fired-power-plant-shuts-down (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Nepal floods]]
**The death toll from the [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s in [[Nepal]] increases to 204 people, with 30 others missing. This is the highest recorded [[monsoon]] rainfall in Nepal in the past two decades. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/sep/30/more-than-200-dead-in-nepal-floods-as-parts-of-kathmandu-left-under-water (''The Guardian'')]
*Two people are killed in [[wildfire]]s in [[Peloponnese (region)|Peloponnese]], [[Greece]], as several villages are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] due to the fires. [https://www.itv.com/news/2024-09-30/two-people-dead-as-wildfire-burns-through-southern-greece (ITV News)]
*Twelve people [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|are killed]], 29 others are rescued, and ten others are missing after a boat [[capsize]]s off the coast of [[Djerba]], [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/30/at-least-12-dead-10-missing-as-boat-capsizes-off-tunisian-coast (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Tuvalu relations]], [[Climate change in Tuvalu]]
**[[Tuvalu]]'s climate minister denounces the [[Australia]]n [[Australian Labor Party|Labor]] [[Australian Government|government]]'s decision to expand three [[Coal mining|coal mines]] as an existential threat to the nation, due to the role of the mines in causing [[Sea level rise|rising sea levels]] that have forced [[List of areas depopulated due to climate change|mass displacement across Tuvalu]]'s low-lying islands. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2024/oct/01/australia-coalmine-decision-akin-to-drowning-its-pacific-neighbours-tuvalu-climate-minister-says (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Shanghai supermarket stabbings]]
**Three people are killed and fifteen others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at a supermarket in [[Songjiang, Shanghai|Songjiang district]], [[Shanghai]], [[China]]. [[Shanghai Municipal Public Security Bureau|Police]] arrest a 37-year-old man at the scene, adding that the man had come to Shanghai in order to "vent his anger due to a personal economic dispute". [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/shanghai-knife-attack-kills-three-wounds-15-others-xinhua-reports-2024-10-01/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9dyxpe2dy1o (BBC News)]
*[[Lithuania]] announces that it has referred [[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]], [[Government of Belarus|the Belarusian government]], [[Armed Forces of Belarus|military officers]], and other security officials to the [[International Criminal Court]] at [[The Hague]], accusing them of committing crimes against humanity and causing people to flee [[Belarus|the country]]. [https://apnews.com/article/icc-lithuania-belarus-court-lukashenko-regime-44c222283c9d0f5529a3b8ee6e8d416f (AP)]
